$playerId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['canonicalName', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('canonicalName').isString() && newData.child('canonicalName').val().length >= 2 && newData.child('canonicalName').val().length <= 60 && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now && newData.child('createdAt').val() > now - 300000

$matchId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['mode', 'startedAt', 'endedAt']) && newData.child('mode').isString() && (newData.child('mode').val() == 'singles' || newData.child('mode').val() == 'doubles' || newData.child('mode').val() == 'practice') && newData.child('startedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('endedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('endedAt').val() <= now && newData.child('endedAt').val() > now - 300000 && newData.child('endedAt').val() >= newData.child('startedAt').val()

$mid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['matchId', 'updatedAt']) && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('updatedAt').val() <= now && newData.child('updatedAt').val() > now - 60000
